parsed.main_gap: Lemma 4 incorrectly infers that the whole multigraph is acyclic from |E|<|V|; disconnected graphs may contain cyclic components.

errors.description: The inference is false: a disconnected graph can have a cyclic component and enough tree or isolated components that |E|<|V| overall. The proof is readily repaired by choosing any component T with fewer edges than vertices, which must be a tree, instead of the component containing vertex n.
errors.quote: Since $|E|<|V|$, the multigraph $G$ contains no cycle and no loop

parsed.notes: Apart from this localized graph-theoretic gap, the reduction, geometric lower bound framework, and subset-sum/cross-pairing upper bound are rigorous. The repair requires no new substantive idea and preserves the claimed answer.
